context: Tests whether the agent correctly runs dld-snapshot on a flat DLD project with no prior state, generates SNAPSHOT.md and OVERVIEW.md according to skill rules, handles an invalid custom artifact (OVERVIEW.md collision), generates a valid custom artifact (ONBOARDING.md), uses correct Mermaid syntax in diagrams, and runs update-snapshot-state.sh with the right arguments.

checklist.name: Full mode triggered
checklist.description: The agent ran detect-snapshot-changes.sh (or recognized no prior .dld-state.yaml) and used full generation mode rather than incremental mode

checklist.name: Only accepted decisions
checklist.description: SNAPSHOT.md contains entries for all five accepted decisions (DL-001 through DL-005) and does NOT include any proposed, superseded, or deprecated entries

checklist.name: Grouped by tag
checklist.description: SNAPSHOT.md groups decisions under tag-based headings (e.g., ## api-design, ## error-handling, ## reliability, ## authentication, ## observability) rather than listing them flat

checklist.name: Mermaid diagram present
checklist.description: OVERVIEW.md contains at least one Mermaid code block (```mermaid ... ```)

checklist.name: Quoted node labels
checklist.description: All Mermaid node labels in OVERVIEW.md use double-quoted bracket syntax ["..."] rather than bare or single-quoted labels

checklist.name: @ escaped as #64;
checklist.description: Any @ symbol appearing inside a Mermaid node or edge label (e.g., referencing @PaymentGateway) is written as #64; rather than a raw @ character

checklist.name: ONBOARDING.md generated
checklist.description: decisions/ONBOARDING.md is present — the valid custom artifact from snapshot_artifacts was generated

checklist.name: OVERVIEW.md collision skipped
checklist.description: The agent did NOT overwrite or duplicate OVERVIEW.md as a custom artifact; the collision with the reserved filename was detected and the entry skipped (snapshot-run-log.txt or other output notes the skip)

checklist.name: State records only the valid artifact
checklist.description: decisions/.dld-state.yaml has a snapshot: block whose 'artifacts:' list includes ONBOARDING.md and does NOT include OVERVIEW.md - the reserved-filename entry must be excluded from the recorded artifact set, not merely skipped during generation.

checklist.name: .dld-state.yaml updated
checklist.description: decisions/.dld-state.yaml exists after the run and contains a snapshot: section with a commit_hash and decisions_included field
